bio.text: Jared Huffman was sworn in to the U.S. House of Representatives on January 3, 2013, and represents California's 2nd Congressional District on the North Coast, from the Golden Gate Bridge to the Oregon border.

Before Congress he served six years in the California State Assembly and 12 years (1994 to 2006) as a director of the Marin Municipal Water District, and earlier worked as a senior attorney for the Natural Resources Defense Council.
He graduated from U.C. Santa Barbara, where he played volleyball, and from Boston College Law School, and lives in San Rafael.
